items.title: Vanishing of the extension by zero along a weakly etale morphism over an affine object all of whose points specialize into a disjoint closed part
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a weakly etale morphism j : U -> X, a closed immersion i : Z -> X disjoint from U and an affine object V of the pro-etale site all of whose points specialize into V_Z, the extension by zero of any abelian sheaf on U has no sections over V (statement lines 5306-5313). The proof (proof lines 5315-5331) refines a given covering to a finite affine one, replaces each member by the localization at its part over Z so that the refinement still covers by the specialization hypothesis, and concludes that no member admits a morphism into U. H2: a three-step refinement argument with two inputs, written out in full.
